statement_blocker: The catalog gives a broad characterization gloss, not a proposition. Direct primary inspection finds Satz 9 on algebraic-closure existence and essential uniqueness, the more general polynomial-family Satz 8, and the relative minimal-closure Satz 2. A modern characteristic/transcendence-degree classification differs again from explicit-basis and uncountable-cardinality forms in pinned mathlib. Pinned mathlib also calls an unrelated primitive-element result Steinitz theorem. Selecting a root without accountable catalog-to-Satz selection and independent review would invent or substitute mathematics.
